name: ACO v0.7.3 final fresh routing holdout 5
purpose: Final fresh routing gate for v0.7.3, frozen after development fixes and before first execution. No routing/hint/example/contract changes are permitted after observing this result.

cases.prompt: This request belongs to one client. Private memory from a different account may look relevant; exclude it unless that specific scope is approved.
Use the current customer private context only. A second client has similar history, but it must remain outside this task.
Two project histories exist; keep the unrelated private project out and carry forward only verified decisions from the authorized scope.
For a self-initiated cultural platform, not a client account, establish brand positioning and architecture before anyone starts identity design.
This is my own independent arts initiative rather than client work; define differentiation and brand architecture before visual execution.
For the client campaign, turn the approved proposition into audience strategy, message structure, channel plan and measurement.
Check whether this residency call fits my artistic practice, verify the deadline and eligibility, and map the application material I need.
Prepare how I should approach a gallery relationship after they requested a studio visit, including what to send and how to follow up.
Organize a dependable artwork inventory with editions, dimensions, locations, condition and documentation status.
Our arts foundation needs a single curatorial logic connecting exhibitions, talks and workshops across the coming year.
Our institution has too many parallel initiatives and unclear owners; define operating priorities, capacity and accountability.
With the client strategy already approved, turn the identity direction into a usable system for type, color, image and layout.
Translate the approved client brand into a responsive website art direction with hierarchy, typography, imagery and interaction rules.
After the latest release, saved records disappear after reload; reproduce the issue, narrow the cause and document the regression.
Prepare a safe production database migration with prechecks, rollback, validation and recovery evidence.
Audit the application for authentication, authorization, secret exposure and data-leak risks, then verify the proposed fixes.
Before signing this commercial services agreement, identify the material risks in payment, IP, liability, termination and jurisdiction.
Map the data-protection duties for this customer-data workflow and processor relationship, including GDPR controls.
Before submitting this application, compare the role requirements with my verified background and identify the real evidence gaps.
I have a formal offer; prepare the negotiation on compensation, title, flexibility and start date.
Forecast incoming and outgoing cash by date and highlight the minimum balance and any liquidity shortfall.
Model direct cost, supplier spend, rights, contingency and target margin before we set the quote.
Assess this prospect against our ideal-customer criteria, credible need, authority and timing before a pitch is built.
Own the response plan for this formal tender, including mandatory documents, scoring requirements and submission controls.
Create the company onboarding sequence for a new hire, covering access, first-week meetings, responsibilities and handoffs.
Turn projected workload and capabilities into employee versus contractor staffing scenarios before hiring begins.
Several workstreams share people and deadlines; build an integrated dependency, milestone and escalation view.
Specify acceptance evidence, review checkpoints and sign-off rules for every deliverable before client handover.
Read the entire office mail thread and draft the appropriate answer for approval without sending it.
Compare travel and hotel options for this work trip and produce a practical itinerary, but make no booking.
A message action ended without a receipt; verify whether it actually sent before any retry or duplicate.
Plan the visual capture of this scene through lenses, framing, lighting, camera movement and continuity.
Turn the locked creative direction into precise AI-video generation instructions and constraints without claiming an output exists.
Restructure the manuscript for argument, chapter order, pacing and reader flow before copyediting.
Check the final publication package for bleed, fonts, image resolution, color setup and printer requirements.
Research current artists, exhibitions and critical writing that materially relate to the artistic work I supplied.
Our cultural organization needs outside artists, researchers and speakers; structure contributor sourcing, fit and availability.
Edit this exhibition essay for precision and structure while keeping its argument and uncertainty intact.
Keep only confirmed decisions, verified outcomes and unresolved next actions for continuity; leave experiments and rejected ideas provisional.
